name: arxiv_math_bench
description: A benchmark of mathematical problems extracted from arXiv papers intended to evaluate a model's ability to perform advanced mathematical reasoning, derivations, and concise answer generation. Tasks typically require understanding formal math notation and producing correct symbolic or textual solutions. It emphasizes research-level and graduate-level mathematics rather than elementary problem solving.
evaluation_method: exact_match (for short/numeric answers) and human_eval (for proofs/derivations)
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset used mainly by specialist groups studying LLM mathematical reasoning; limited mainstream adoption.
